column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 2 - Summer Comiket Arc
Ah, my heart. It hurts. It hurts so much...
That I might report this to your sister.
Please don't do that!
Oh? Why not? It's not like you were doing anything shameful, were you?
It doesn't matter what I'm doing, just don't! She'll definitely misunderstand and give me hell for it!
Hmph. That's none of my concern.
Gah! Come on!
Would you mind cutting it out already?
Geh! A-Ayase?
You stay out of this, Sweets #2. Can't you see I'm talking to Senpai?
No, I will not. Ah, I see now. So you're the pretentious emo creep.
Wha-... P-Pretentious... e-e-emo creep?
Hey, I feel like I've seen this before.
It seems like I was right. In fact, I didn't know quite what that meant, not until I saw your pathetic behavior.
I thought, oh, this must be the so called "pretentious emo creep" that Kirino says she hates so much.
M-My, aren't we cheeky. I guess a bitch only makes friends with other bitches.
Bitch...? You mean... Kirino?
Heh, what if I do?
...Heh heh.
W-What an overwhelming murderous aura. I see, so that's how it is. Hehe. You've disguised yourself well, monster.
So you were hiding your Super Bitch identity while trying to ensnare Senpai.
I won't stand for that. I won't be responsible... for what might happen next.
Stop!!!
Should you two really get at each other's throats right in the middle of 【Summer Comiket】?
Seriously, you two really don't mix well! I've been with you this whole time and I have no idea how this turned into a fight!
That's because you're an idiot.
Do you have cotton for brains, Onii-san?
Guh...
Why are they only on the same page when they're aiming at me?
But I think I get it now.
This is a fight between two of Kirino's friends.
So in a way... It's a fight about Kirino.
What a pain.
And as such, Ayase's first meeting with Kuroneko turned into a magnificent battle.
It's kind of like when Kirino and Kuroneko first met.
No, actually... These two get along even worse than that time.
It would seem as if there's not even the slightest chance that we might ever become friends.
Indeed. Now that you understand that, would you please get out of my sight? Do so while the hellfire dwelling in my right arm stays dormant.
...Would you two please stop it already?
Alright. Time to step in and break them up.
Man, getting Kuroneko to keep quiet took ages.
*sigh*... As for you, Ayase, did you really have to take it so seriously?
But...
Um... Onii-san?
Mm?
What is your relation with that girl?
Relation?
I'm just asking.
Hmm... The relation between Kuroneko and me, huh. It's kinda complicated.
I think a chill just ran down my spine.
Let's see... R-Right, I guess she's...
My precious junior...
Your precious junior...
My sister's precious friend...
Kirino's precious friend...
And my friend as well.
I see.
So, why'd you want to know?
No reason. I just felt like asking.
Hmm?
Continuing the pointless conversation, we headed toward the west hall and the commercial booths.
On our way there...
Wow... That's cosplay, isn't it?
Yeah. Amazing, isn't it?
Yes. They all seem to be having fun.
That's not a bad reaction.
I also found it quite interesting when I first came here a year ago.
Actually... This could be a good chance to improve her impression of these things.
Look over there, Ayase.
Eh?
You should be able to recognize that character.
Which one?
There, that girl. She's cosplaying a character from Stardust ☆ Witch Meruru.
That's Thanatos!
Gah!
W-Why are you making me look at that lewd cosplay, you pervert?!
You're over-thinking it! I was just trying to find something you'd recognize.
No, I don't believe you. You were planning to make me wear something like that again!
Oh, hey. Look at that crowd!
Don't go changing the subject like that!
Oh, come on! Let's go take a look!
Ah, wait! Geez...
Meruru! Meruru! Hey hey hey hey!
Yeah!
Woo!
The stage we were heading to was set up for use by the companies.
There were a lot of otaku there and they were still gathering.
Meruru's PV was playing on the stage.
...Onii-san, I think I've seen this somewhere before.
...How strange. So have I.
Kirino's comrades have all gathered here, which must mean...
Ah, Ayase!
Ah!
Eh... K-K-Kanako?!
Sup?
Of course.
Kurusu Kanako. Classmate and friend of both Ayase and Kirino.
A little brat who's also a model at the same agency as Ayase.
I know what she's thinking.
Why did I bump into Kanako at 【Summer Comiket】?!
This is bad...
Hehe. Oh, Ayase. Geez～
E-Eh? What?
No need to play dumb. You're here to see my show, right?
Lucky! Her misunderstanding gives us an easy way out.
Y-Yeah. That's it.
I knew it! Aww, that's so sweet of you!
Um, what kind of show is it?
Right, that. I'm cosplaying for the Meruru event.
See all these people here? They're all my followers. Awesome, eh?
And you even hated cosplay at first. I guess you don't mind anymore, huh.
Huh? Who the hell are you?
